svg.title: 2 The approach
svg.desc: Section 2, The approach. My work builds federated learning on lattice-based cryptography, the family NIST standardised in 2024 as ML-KEM (FIPS 203) and ML-DSA (FIPS 204). Its security rests on the learning with errors problem. Equation 1: b = A s + e mod q. Given A and b, recovering the secret s is believed to be hard even for a quantum computer. The aim is a protocol in which updates stay protected and every participant can verify the aggregate. Details will follow with publication. Figure 2. One lattice, two bases. The short basis is the secret trapdoor and the long, skewed one is public. Both enclose the same area.
